name: MoonJuice
description: Library for TASBox's custom scripting language that transpiles to Lua.
In most cases you won't need to use this, as the Luau library automatically transpiles MoonJuice scripts ending in `.mj`.

functions.name: toLuau
functions.description: Transpiles the provided MoonJuice source code to Luau, returning the first syntax error if any.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the source file for formatting errors.

returns.name: transpiledSource
returns.description: Transpiled Luau source code. Empty string if there were errors.

returns.name: syntaxError
returns.description: The first syntax error hit while transpiling, or `nil` if the source is valid.
